verdict.rationale: A desktop OS platform could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents none: the only versioning evidence is the OS release lifecycle (each version updated for about 13 months). That is a distribution support window, not API versioning or an API deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
